official_source.title: GitHub REST API endpoints for repository contents - Create or update file contents
official_source.relevant_contract: For an existing file update, sha is required and is the blob SHA of the file being replaced; the endpoint documents 409 Conflict as a response status.

direct_role_local_observation.desired_payload_relation: byte-equivalent semantic payload to the current LATEST body used only to make unexpected acceptance minimally destructive

tested_inference.stale_expected_blob_rejection: supported for this exact role-local GitHub Contents API observation
tested_inference.content_level_duplicate_discrimination: After a stale conflict, an exact read of the current file plus equality comparison against the intended payload can distinguish 'desired payload already present' from 'desired payload differs from current'. The former is sufficient for idempotent duplicate suppression at payload level; the latter remains an unapplied or distinct-loser case.
tested_inference.causal_identity_limit: Content equality does not identify which writer produced the current content, prove absence of intermediate equal writes, or reconstruct full concurrency history. Therefore this is payload-level duplicate-vs-different-state discrimination, not writer-identity proof.

scope_guard: Tested only GitHub repository-contents update CAS behavior on one role-local JSON path with one stale expected blob. No O/downstream/other-worker semantics, hosted compute, finite credits, manual execution, scheduler mutation, automatic merge, multi-provider behavior, or generalized linearizability claim.
